item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 13 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 13 #VISPRSD
Issued at 11:07 PM 03 September 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Aklan(Ibajay, Malinao, Madalag), #Antique(Barbaza), #Iloilo(Pavia, Oton, Tigbauan), #Guimaras(Buenavista and SanLorenzo) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Antique(Pandan, Sebaste, Culasi, Tibiao), #Iloilo(IloiloCity, Leganes, Zarraga, Dumangas), #Guimaras(Jordan and Sibunag) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.
